title: HOLY SH*T: THE FED RESERVE *JUST* BAILED US OUT
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Calls peak 10y yields around 5.25 after the 10y hit 5.29 intraday.
NY Fed Williams signalled the next hike can wait until December, cutting odds of an October hike below 50%; seen as cover to cap yields.
Lack of guidance lets markets tighten conditions and risks breaking regional banks.
No deal yet, but pressure on Iran rising; maintains bullish posture and sold puts on a name that benefits from a deal.

calls.reason: Thinks the Fed is now actively trying to cap yields and that 5.25% is about the peak.
calls.quote: I think we're getting to peak yields. Inverse trade me if you want.

calls.reason: Peak-yield view expressed as TLT holding/regaining its 77-78 line; says he is not betting on TLT himself.
calls.quote: I think we hold this line, or we will regain this line, the 78-77 line on TLT.

calls.reason: Sees the Fed dovish shift as a reiteration of bullishness; expects an Iran deal eventually.
calls.quote: Anyway, I maintain my bullish posture.

notes: Date: Williams' comments 'Tuesday' and 'earlier today we were at 5.29' -> Tue 2026-09-29 (listing said 09-30). Also Kalshi bets: Iran nuclear deal before Mar 1 (>19%) and exactly one more hike; not market calls.
